question: Which licensed runtime notes are reachable and adopted by the Product Agent, and which ones actually reduce long-tail calls rather than merely adding correct fallback knowledge?

six_case_time_neighbor.boundary: This batch used experimental final11 before the final12/final13 pruning. Aggregate differences in cases that received no note are sampling variation and are not attributed to the Catalog.

Assembly.Set.native_edge_sequence.interpretation: Strong small-sample long-tail reduction for the pre-existing Assembly.Set note; later output-protocol evidence below prevents a stable-success guarantee.

Part.SectionAssignment.direct_region.decision: Pruned from final12/final13 because it duplicated normal Skill/official guidance and increased calls in this batch.

Part.setElementType.region_dispatch.interpretation: The note is a correct and reliably routed fallback, but the simple fixture showed no call reduction.

Assembly.Surface.side1Edges.interpretation: Mixed positive evidence: pass count rose from 1/3 to 3/3 and calls fell from 11 to 9, but one passing automatic run diverted to probes and never received the note.

pre_fix_failures_after_functional_repair.failure: The model returned prose instead of the strict decision tool, then misread Pydantic's Invalid JSON retry as a workspace artifact error.
The same output retry was mistaken for result-file JSON corruption, causing byte/BOM/atomic-write probes.

output_policy_follow_up.detail: The model chose a proactive isolated Surface probe, so automatic error routing was not exercised.

exact_artifact_and_output_protocol.interpretation: The clarified output-tool descriptions and instructions remove a reproduced source of post-repair probe waste in two one-attempt follow-ups. This is regression evidence, not a stable success-rate estimate.

final13_beam_section_case.licensed_broken_fixture: 1/1 failed before result creation with the expected orientation keyword error
final13_beam_section_case.interpretation: No Product call benefit was observed because both runs repaired the API boundary from source inspection before the first CAE call. The verified note remains a routed fallback for runtime-error paths.

limits: All Product results are small local samples with one model/gateway and cannot establish a general success rate.
Automatic notes are reactive. They cannot reduce calls when the model repairs from source inspection or chooses a proactive probe before triggering the broken call.
A delivered note does not guarantee convergence; structured-output behavior and unrelated model decisions can dominate after the API fix.
Only verified notes with a repeated or high-cost boundary were retained. Correct but redundant notes were pruned rather than maximizing note count.
